title: Great app concept but too many bugs
body:
I like the app concept, especially now that I can configure the runs on the phone and start them from phone or watch to track the same run either from phone or watch. The configurable running intervals are great, as well as the import that is possible from other apps. Some enhancements and bug fixes are necessary though:

1. Sometimes custom trainings configured on the phone are not available on the watch
2. saving the training on the phone does sometimes not work. If I edit a training I always send it to myself in a message before hitting the save button, because often it was not saved. As a workaround I can then use the import from my message.
3. Trainings sometimes just stop and the data is lost
4. Sometimes a training started from the phone does not start on the watch. If I then open the training app on the phone a second training starts with a separate starting time.
5. there seems to be some synchronization issue with Apple fitness. When I tried to reset my watch to test of the stability gets better I lost data, including badges for completed trainings or achievements 

Dear Apple team: Test this app better! I really think the quality decreased over the last couple of years, not sure what organizational changes are involved that apps are released with so many bugs that are not fixed over time. Also when reporting problems it is too mich effort to get in calls with the support engineers to get the report into the next level and to the development team. Issues need to be reported back to the team without the need of the user to get into calls with Apple if provided with enough evidence.

body: I've been using the Apple Fitness app for tracking my daily activities, whether it's walking or running, and I've encountered several frustrating issues. Whether it's achieving the 100-day Move ring (which I've completed), 365-day Move ring (which I haven't tried yet), or surpassing the 200% or 400% Move ring per day, the app consistently fails to stay up-to-date with its own data. This lack of timely recognition is incredibly disappointing and undermines the motivation to maintain these fitness milestones. Apple needs to address these issues to ensure a smoother and more rewarding user experience.
